subject: sg
title: SG.------FUND.DYM.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 210 (WAC-8). SG (source initiation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: FUND-DYN (fundamental dynamics), PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and COP-P. From PROJ-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From COP-P: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From INDIV-TD: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From PHY-U-C: TR-DIFF. From POL-DYM: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). From TR-DIFF: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From PHY-U-P: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
